description: Prompt configuration for symbolic motif images that are composited over independently generated quote backgrounds. Each motif uses one coherent visual style selected independently from the background style. The generated asset should contain one recognizable symbolic motif surrounded by a style-appropriate vignette that dissolves naturally toward transparent edges during later compositing.

inputs.motif: The symbolic subject to depict, for example an antique clock, open door, key, mirror, staircase, eye, hourglass, tree, labyrinth, flame, broken chain or moon.

template: This is an RGBA image with transparency. Create a single isolated symbolic motif: {{motif}}. {{medium}}. Visual treatment: {{treatment}}. {{edgeTreatment}} The motif must remain immediately recognizable, but may be transformed, fragmented, stylized, illuminated or partially abstracted according to the selected visual style. Present it as a self-contained artistic vignette rather than as an object photographed against a scene. Keep the main motif fully inside the canvas with generous clear space around it. The visual treatment should be strongest around the motif and progressively dissolve outward. No full environment, no narrative scene, no typography. The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.

globalInstructions: Select exactly one style profile. Never combine treatments from different style profiles.
The style of the motif is independent of the style of the background onto which it will later be composited.
The motif must remain recognizable at normal viewing size.
Stylization may transform the motif strongly, but should not replace it with an unrelated scene or object.
Generate one dominant symbolic motif only.
Do not generate a full environment around the motif.
Do not place the motif on a floor, table, landscape or other conventional scene unless that surface is inseparable from the motif itself.
Do not use a rectangular card, badge, medallion, poster or decorative frame around the motif.
Instead of a literal frame, create an irregular style-appropriate vignette whose visual density decreases outward from the motif.
Keep the outer canvas relatively sparse so the motif can be isolated cleanly.
Keep the entire motif inside the image boundaries. Do not crop important portions.
Leave generous padding around the motif for later scaling and positioning.
The visual centre should contain the strongest detail and opacity.
Peripheral smoke, particles, fragments, lines, glow, paint, geometry or material should become progressively less dense toward the outer boundary.
Avoid tiny details that disappear when the motif is displayed at a smaller size.
Do not generate typography, labels or pseudo-text.
Do not add unrelated symbolic objects unless explicitly included in the motif input.
The motif should work at multiple placements and scales when composited over a separate background.

selectionRules.styleSelection: Select exactly one style profile using weighted random selection from styleProfiles. The selection must be independent of the background's style.
selectionRules.mediumSelection: Select one medium only from the chosen style profile.
selectionRules.treatmentSelection: Select one treatment only from the chosen style profile.
selectionRules.edgeTreatmentSelection: Select one edge treatment only from the chosen style profile.
selectionRules.randomness: Random selections must be performed by application code rather than delegated to the language model.
selectionRules.motifIntegrity: Preserve the recognizable identity of the requested motif even when heavily stylized.
selectionRules.sceneAvoidance: Do not generate a conventional surrounding scene. The asset is intended to be composited over another independently generated image.
selectionRules.edgeBehavior: The generated visual content should naturally become less dense toward the image perimeter. Transparency comes from Qwen Image 2.1's RGBA mode, which the template's opening and closing sentences ('This is an RGBA image with transparency.' ... 'The image has alpha channel and the background is transparent.') switch on; the workflow has no separate matting step, so keep those sentences.

assetComposition.canvas: Prefer a square source canvas for reusable motif assets.
assetComposition.subjectCoverage: The core motif should normally occupy approximately 55 to 70 percent of the canvas dimension.
assetComposition.padding: Leave substantial open space around every side of the motif.
assetComposition.core: The central motif should contain the strongest contrast, recognizability and detail.
assetComposition.perimeter: Only secondary glow, smoke, particles, lines, fragments, paint strokes or other style-specific material should extend toward the perimeter.
assetComposition.alpha: Final transparency comes from Qwen Image 2.1's RGBA output, triggered by the template's transparency sentences. Partial alpha for glow, fog, smoke, fine strands and other soft peripheral material is kept wherever the model produces it.
